Check [Pi might look random but it's full of hidden patterns](https://phys.org/news/2016-03-pi-random-full-hidden-patterns.html) .

I don’t see why “a sphere of say 1 meter in diameter and place it in a 1 meter cube it would be exactly 52.3598775598298 percent of the cube”

the volume of the sphere is V=4*pi*(1/2)^3/3 which is pi/6, so it has also an infinite number of decimals so it is not “exactly 52.3598775598298 percent of the cube”

[pi/6 1000 decimals - Wolfram|Alpha](https://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=pi/6+1000+decimals) gives

0.
